title: Deanny's Golden Foods
description: This mod adds golden foods to almost every food item in the game
body:
# More Golden Foods

Vanilla golden apples and golden carrots — but for **every other food in the game**.

Craft 31 golden food recipes, hunt down 35 enchanted variants and 4 legendary golden stews in chest loot, and eat any of them for tiered status effects. 70 new items in total.

---

## What's in the mod

- **35 golden foods** covering every vanilla edible the game doesn't already gold-plate: meats, fish, breads, soups, sweets, and oddballs (golden rotten flesh, golden poisonous potato, golden spider eye).
- **35 enchanted golden variants** with **1.75× effect duration**, EPIC rarity, and the enchantment glint. Loot-only — they cannot be crafted.
- **31 crafting recipes** — surround any base food with 8 gold ingots in the crafting grid, the classic golden-apple pattern.
- **Chest loot** in **12 vanilla loot tables across 11 structure types** — see the loot table below.
- **Always edible** — eat any of them on a full hunger bar; effects apply regardless.
- **Client + server side, no config required.**

---

## Full item list

**Meats:** Golden Beef, Golden Cooked Beef, Golden Porkchop, Golden Cooked Porkchop, Golden Chicken, Golden Cooked Chicken, Golden Mutton, Golden Cooked Mutton, Golden Rabbit, Golden Cooked Rabbit
**Fish:** Golden Cod, Golden Cooked Cod, Golden Salmon, Golden Cooked Salmon, Golden Tropical Fish, Golden Pufferfish, Golden Dried Kelp
**Crops & sweets:** Golden Bread, Golden Cookie, Golden Melon Slice, Golden Sweet Berries, Golden Glow Berries, Golden Pumpkin Pie, Golden Honey Bottle, Golden Beetroot, Golden Potato, Golden Baked Potato
**Stews (loot only):** Golden Mushroom Stew, Golden Beetroot Soup, Golden Rabbit Stew, Golden Suspicious Stew
**Oddballs:** Golden Rotten Flesh, Golden Spider Eye, Golden Poisonous Potato, Golden Chorus Fruit

Every item above also has an **Enchanted Golden** variant.

---

## Effect tiers

| Tier | Foods | Effects |
|---|---|---|
| **Basic** | raw meats, raw fish, basic crops | Regen I, 5s |
| **Mid** | cooked meats, bread, cookie, baked potato, dried kelp, berries, melon slice | Regen I, 8s + Speed I, 30s |
| **Elite** | pumpkin pie, honey bottle, chorus fruit | Regen II, 8s + Absorption I, 60s + Speed I, 60s |
| **Legendary** *(loot only)* | mushroom stew, beetroot soup, rabbit stew, suspicious stew | Regen II 12s + Absorption II 120s + Resistance I 120s + Strength I 60s |

Quirky flavors keep their character but lose the downsides:
- Golden spider eye → **Strength** (no poison)
- Golden rotten flesh → **Resistance** (no hunger)
- Golden poisonous potato → **Luck** (no poison)
- Golden pufferfish → **Water Breathing + Conduit Power** (no nausea)
- Golden chorus fruit → keeps the random teleport, plus Speed

Enchanted versions apply the same effects with **1.75× duration**.

---

## How to craft
[G] [G] [G]
[G] [F] [G] G = Gold Ingot
[G] [G] [G] F = the base food

Works for all 31 craftable golden foods. Stews and enchanted variants are chest-loot only — go exploring.

---

## Chest loot drop chances

| Loot table | Chance per chest |
|---|---|
| End city treasure | 40% |
| Bastion treasure | 35% |
| Ancient city | 35% |
| Woodland mansion | 30% |
| Buried treasure | 25% |
| Stronghold corridor | 22% |
| Stronghold crossing | 22% |
| Simple dungeon | 20% |
| Abandoned mineshaft | 18% |
| Desert pyramid | 18% |
| Jungle temple | 18% |

When the roll succeeds, one random enchanted golden food or golden stew is added to the chest.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 26.1.2
- **NeoForge:** 26.1.2.29-beta

---

## Note on existing vanilla goldens

Vanilla already ships `golden_apple`, `enchanted_golden_apple`, and `golden_carrot` — those are not duplicated. Everything else gets the gold treatment.
